========== SUMMARY_BEH.txt ==========
BEHAVIOUR-REFERENCED TRAINING BUDGET - RETROSPECTIVE TEST (no training)

How to read (the behaviour-referenced hypothesis is supported if):
  1  M-RT3 has the smallest (or an unusually small) eps_beh / eps_sig for the SP metric;
  2  in SUPERVISED CEBRA, x_beh (lin and/or nl) has a higher AUC and LOSO accuracy for the broken
     decoders than x_sig, and SP_AUTO in M-RT3 has a larger x_beh than SP_AUTO in the four sessions
     it rescued (C-RT6, T-RT4, J-CO0, T-RT1);
  3  in TIME-ONLY CEBRA, x_sig does at least as well as x_beh (the time-contrastive encoder keeps
     all slow structure);
  4  the eps_beh rule would give supervised SP in M-RT3 a budget well below 8.24, while the budgets
     of the rescued sessions stay near the ones that worked (3.7-5.8).
